basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Forward-Deployed / Client Integration Engineer
basics.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 4+ years of experience delivering enterprise features, integrating APIs and data pipelines, and translating business needs into reliable technical solutions. Brings hands-on Java, TypeScript, React, SQL, and cloud experience together with cross-functional communication, requirements discovery, and client-oriented delivery.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Full-stack engineer delivering enterprise financial platform integrations and translating partner and stakeholder needs into production solutions.
highlights: Led end-to-end delivery of large-scale features for global partners, from design and test-driven development through deployment and ongoing support.
Collaborated across departments to define API specifications, stored procedure interfaces, business logic, and expected outcomes for integrated solutions.
Translated business needs into technical requirements and iterative delivery plans while driving story creation, sprint refinement, and Agile execution for international integrations.
Developed full-stack features with TypeScript, React, and Redux on the frontend and Spring Boot with Java 21 on the backend, integrating with internal enterprise systems.
Optimized Oracle SQL schemas and stored procedures, JPA/Hibernate mappings, and high-throughput Apache Kafka pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions.
Consolidated disparate historical storage into Snowflake on Azure, optimizing storage costs while maintaining high availability for cross-functional teams.
Built automated health-check tooling and validation scripts to detect and remediate deployment regressions, improving operational stability for supported solutions.
Produced system specifications, process flowcharts, maintenance guides, and troubleshooting strategies to support knowledge transfer and long-term customer and team support.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Built security tooling and partnered with stakeholders to improve vulnerability detection, remediation, and enterprise product reliability.
highlights: Built a React/Redux security dashboard for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
Resolved critical logic flaws in security risk-scoring algorithms, improving data accuracy and reducing false-positive alerts for enterprise clients.
Implemented Jest and Cypress testing suites to improve feature reliability and UI performance across staging and production environments.
Implemented keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes to support accessibility compliance and screen-reader users.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Delivered tailored automation solutions by translating enterprise workflow needs into full-stack technical implementations.
highlights: Orchestrated full-stack automation solutions with C#/.NET and SQL for enterprise workflows across OCR, HR, and fundraising departments.
Identified manual bottlenecks and delivered tailored solutions for a diverse portfolio of clients, including a non-profit medical organization.
